event.description: Make FF sublayers block-diagonal across attention heads
event.proposal: family: feed-forward width; current retained incumbent is 3136 parameters at 99.9500%, a +0.95 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0031, full ff16 sublayers with per-head attention output at 3136/99.95%; same-family failed result: attempt-0033, the one-unit ff15 reduction at 3072/56.60%; prior attempts in this family: 10. Hypothesis: ff15 showed that removing an entire hidden unit is too abrupt, but the successful attention block-diagonalization suggests that cross-head FF mixing may be redundant. Keep each head's ff16-width capacity in the sense of two independent 8-wide nonlinear maps, but remove only cross-head FF weights, reducing each FF from 512 to 256 parameters and the model to 2624. This is more informative than another scalar width decrement because it preserves the nonlinear width per head while isolating FF connectivity; the nearest untested alternative is low-rank factorization of each full FF matrix, which changes within-head rank as well. Keep two layers, d16/h2, independent head-local attention maps, MQA, affine-free block pre-norms, final affine norm, learned positions, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3136 parameters.
